out.subject: Volume-tier proposal for stainless bar supply
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the alloy, labour and processing cost drivers. We appreciate your support from stock. For this business, please assess a dedicated volume tier rather than the quoted package.

Our proposed agreement covers a fixed annual volume of 94800 kg throughout a 24-month contract. The latest shared monthly forecast is attached; see the figures below for the supporting demand data. This gives you a concrete basis for planning the volume tier.

We propose EUR 4.58 per kg, with payment at 90 days net and no price adjustment clause, for the 24-month term. Please review these terms as a complete package and confirm the dedicated volume-tier price you can offer on that basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Open with the deepest available level on the fixed-price, extended-payment package, supported by the fixed annual volume and attached forecast.

out.subject: Re: Bar supply – revised volume package
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for accepting the 24-month term and payment at 90 days net, and for taking the forecast into account. Those terms give us a useful basis for the agreement.

I understand your concern about raw-material volatility and the reason for including an AS-14404 clause. Your fixed-price material cover described in your letter does, however, provide some protection against that exposure. Please reconsider a fixed price for the agreed term on the committed volume basis.

Our purchase-order history also provides a concrete reference for the business already placed with you; see the figures below. Please take that trading history into account alongside the forecast when reviewing the volume-tier price.

We can improve our proposal to EUR 4.77 per kg, with payment at 90 days net, a 24-month contract and no price adjustment clause. Please review this revised package and let us know how far you can reduce your price on that basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Retain the accepted payment and contract terms, raise the price proposal to the closest available level to the planned move, and introduce purchase-order evidence. Address the index objection using the supplier's stated material cover without proposing an index clause.

out.subject: Revised price proposal for stainless bar
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for reducing your offer and confirming payment at 90 days net over the 24-month term. I also appreciate your verification of our purchase-order history, even though you have not changed your calculation on that basis.

I understand that your material cover does not extend over the full agreement and that this is why you require an alloy index clause. Separately, the recent movement in PPI-C2431 warrants a review of the processing component of your price; see the figures below. Please take that movement into account alongside the annual volume already discussed.

We can raise our proposal to EUR 4.87 per kg, with payment at 90 days net, a 24-month contract and no price adjustment clause. This remains our proposed fixed-price package, rather than acceptance of the indexed offer. Please review the revised price and confirm what further reduction you can offer.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Raises the proposed price while retaining the same payment, duration and fixed-price structure. Acknowledges the supplier's material-cover objection and introduces verified processing-index evidence as a separate reason to review its price.
